title: Unique Window
statement: A password auditor wants to know the longest stretch of a string in which no character repeats.
Find the length of the longest contiguous substring whose characters are all different.
inputFormat: A single line containing a nonempty string of lowercase letters `a`–`z`.
outputFormat: Print the length of the longest substring with no repeated character.
constraints: The string contains only lowercase ASCII letters.

examples.explanation: "bcadef" is the longest window without a repeat.

starter.output: the length of the longest substring without repeated characters

private.complexity: O(n) sliding window storing the last index of each letter. Restarting from every position is O(26n) which also passes; O(n^2) substring checks time out.
private.notes: When a repeat is found, move the left edge to max(left, last[c] + 1); never move it backwards (see 'abba').
